decisions.rationale: It reports Method M+ cardinality relative to CERT-ED but omits Method M’s mixed results, leaving the finding’s method scope incomplete.
It gives Method M’s disadvantage only on Yelp and LUN, omitting SpamAssassin and Method M+’s lower accuracy versus CERT-ED across all datasets.
It correctly compares Method M with CERT-ED across all datasets but omits the required RanMASK comparison, so the finding’s comparator scope is incomplete.
“Did not consistently outperform” understates the uniform result: both Method M and M+ had lower clean accuracy than CERT-ED on every dataset.
